78406.body:
View this post on the web at https://linas.substack.com/p/fintechpulse1121

Hey Everyone,
Good morning & happy Wednesday! Today, we’re breaking down Revolut AIR's EU launch to see why the real competitive battle isn't against Starling but against bunq's Finn (how AIR's product discovery play differs from Finn's support roots, why Revolut's 80M users and 11 £100M+ revenue lines create a cross-sell engine bunq structurally can't match, how last week's Revolut Research launch connects directly to the EU rollout timing & what’s next + bonus deep dives into PRAGMA [ https://substack.com/redirect/62104135-78f3-4eaa-ae1d-20fce59909b4?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], Are We Bullish Enough on Revolut? [ https://substack.com/redirect/ac0fef51-e2f5-42fb-bb0c-c2fbf8e10783?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] & Revolut’s EURR stablecoin [ https://substack.com/redirect/642fd936-be44-4f75-a93c-647cfc482096?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside), and Grok Bot's agentic shopping launch to see why the real story here is not yet another AI agent buying a Starlink Mini (how Stripe Link mints a throwaway card the AI bot never sees, why the human tap on every charge is a liability strategy rather than a missing feature, the split between Google's and SpaceXAI's agentic AI approaches & what to watch next + bonus deep dives into Stripe [ https://substack.com/redirect/48870526-34e2-46b2-ab32-1ba60495eaa8?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], Google [ https://substack.com/redirect/d6e2ce85-7180-4754-9ef7-4ee20fc61a32?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ], and The Ultimate Guide to Grok Bot: The First Real AI Agent OS [ https://substack.com/redirect/9fb81b9b-a05e-4fa6-bca6-377029065e7d?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] inside). So let’s just jump straight into the finnovative stuff 🌶️
Revolut AIR launches across Europe, but one EU neobank already has better AI numbers 🤖🇪🇺
The news 🗞️ Five months after its UK launch, Revolut’s AI assistant [ https://substack.com/redirect/ca5abb78-772b-4f6f-9c95-ddf605ade3c4?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ] just crossed the pond and got into the only European market where it faces a competitor with genuinely better operational numbers.
AIR started rolling out across the EU yesterday, beginning with Germany 🇩🇪 and Austria 🇦🇹. And this isn’t just a replay of the UK launch, where Starling was the nearest rival with a fraction of the user base. In Europe, Revolut runs directly into bunq’s Finn. Live since 2023, Finn handles 97% of support volume across 38 languages and is arguably the most mature AI assistant in European banking.
